description: Fetch the full RPO record for one entity: legal forms, registered address history, statutory bodies (directors/executives), stakeholders (owners/partners), equity and shares, predecessors (mergers/splits), statistical classification codes, and the source register (Obchodný register / Živnostenský register / etc.) with registration number. Pass either `id` (the internal RPO id returned by rpo_search_entity) or `ico` (the 8-digit IČO) — if you pass `ico`, this tool resolves it to the internal id first via an exact-identifier search.

ico.description: IČO — the 8-digit Slovak business identifier, e.g. "31333532". Used to look up the entity if `id` is not given.

id.description: Internal RPO entity id, from rpo_search_entity results (the `id` field).

includeHistory.description: Include historical (superseded) names, addresses, legal forms etc., not just the current ones. Default true.

includeOrganizationUnits.description: Include organizational units (branches) of the entity. Default true.

name: rpo_entity_detail
title: Rpo Entity Detail
